answer: Beacon decay stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits in a vault, holding a sable beacon. Each epoch the tide table names a probe minute; the beacon answers in 10 minutes with a key-signed tide reading auditors check. Missed, late, or copied readings decay the bond 10; at zero it burns. At 36+7(k-1), 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500, tying up 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-tide rings fail: readings are time-bound. Honest agents pay 36 once.
